using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using Azure.Core;
using Hashbrown.AspNetCore;
using Hashbrown.Conformance.Testing;
using Microsoft.Extensions.AI;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;

static void Check(bool value, string reason) { if (!value) throw new Exception(reason); }
static FixtureLiveRecoveryScope Scope() => new("scope", "thread", "run");
static JsonElement View(FixtureLiveRecoveryEvidence value) => JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(value.Snapshot("scope", "thread"));
foreach (var selection in new[] { "openai-key", "azure-key", "azure-cli" })
{
    var azure = selection.StartsWith("azure", StringComparison.Ordinal);
    var configuration = new ConfigurationBuilder().AddInMemoryCollection(new Dictionary<string, string?> {
        ["Provider"] = azure ? "azure" : "openai", ["ModelApi"] = "responses", ["Model"] = "gpt-4.1-mini", ["ModelEndpoint"] = azure ? "https://native-unit.invalid/" : "https://native-unit.invalid/v1/",
        ["AzureAuthentication"] = selection == "azure-cli" ? "azure-cli" : "api-key", ["ApiKey"] = selection == "azure-cli" ? null : "private-canary-key"
    }).Build();
    using var evidence = new FixtureLiveRecoveryEvidence("preflight", TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60), Scope);
    var credential = new ScopeCredential();
    var transport = new NativeHandler();
    using var audit = new FixtureLiveRecoveryHttpHandler(evidence, "gpt-4.1-mini", "responses", transport);
    using var http = new HttpClient(audit);
    using var client = new FixtureLiveRecoveryClient(ProviderFactory.Create(configuration, new ProviderClientComposition(_ => credential, http)), evidence);
    var response = await client.GetResponseAsync([new(ChatRole.User, "Reply OK")]);
    Check(response.Text == "ok", "genuine SDK response changed");
    Check(transport.Calls == 1 && transport.StreamDisposed, "native wire count/disposal changed");
    Check(transport.ActualPath == (azure ? "/openai/v1/responses" : "/v1/responses"), "native provider path changed");
    using var body = JsonDocument.Parse(transport.ActualBody!);
    Check(body.RootElement.GetProperty("model").GetString() == "gpt-4.1-mini" && body.RootElement.GetProperty("max_output_tokens").GetInt32() == 384 && body.RootElement.GetProperty("store").ValueKind == JsonValueKind.False, "native body policy changed");
    Check(View(evidence).GetProperty("healthy").GetBoolean() && View(evidence).GetProperty("calls")[0].GetProperty("validUsage").GetBoolean(), "native usage lost");
    if (selection == "azure-cli") Check(credential.Scopes.Single().SequenceEqual(new[] { "https://ai.azure.com/.default" }) && transport.ActualAuthentication == "bearer", "Azure CLI HTTPS scope/authentication changed");
    Check(!View(evidence).GetRawText().Contains("private-canary", StringComparison.Ordinal), "credential leaked into passive proof");
}
var exact = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("{ \"model\": \"gpt-4.1-mini\", \"store\":false, \"max_output_tokens\":384, \"input\":[] }");
using (var evidence = new FixtureLiveRecoveryEvidence("preflight", TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60), Scope))
{
    evidence.Begin([new(ChatRole.User, "exact body")]);
    var transport = new NativeHandler();
    using var http = new HttpClient(new FixtureLiveRecoveryHttpHandler(evidence, "gpt-4.1-mini", "responses", transport));
    using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "https://native-unit.invalid/v1/responses") { Content = new ByteArrayContent(exact) };
    request.Headers.Authorization = new("Bearer", "private-canary-token");
    using var response = await http.SendAsync(request);
    Check(transport.ActualBody!.SequenceEqual(exact), "HTTP audit rewrote native entity bytes");
}
foreach (var (method, path, body, auth) in new[] {
    ("GET", "https://native-unit.invalid/v1/responses", Encoding.UTF8.GetString(exact), true),
    ("POST", "http://native-unit.invalid/v1/responses", Encoding.UTF8.GetString(exact), true),
    ("POST", "https://native-unit.invalid/v1/chat/completions", Encoding.UTF8.GetString(exact), true),
    ("POST", "https://native-unit.invalid/v1/responses", Encoding.UTF8.GetString(exact).Replace("384", "385"), true),
    ("POST", "https://native-unit.invalid/v1/responses", Encoding.UTF8.GetString(exact).Replace("gpt-4.1-mini", "wrong-model"), true),
    ("POST", "https://native-unit.invalid/v1/responses", Encoding.UTF8.GetString(exact).Replace("false", "true"), true),
    ("POST", "https://native-unit.invalid/v1/responses", Encoding.UTF8.GetString(exact).Replace("\"store\":false,", ""), true),
    ("POST", "https://native-unit.invalid/v1/responses", Encoding.UTF8.GetString(exact), false),
})
{
    using var evidence = new FixtureLiveRecoveryEvidence("preflight", TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60), Scope);
    evidence.Begin([new(ChatRole.User, "invalid wire")]);
    var transport = new NativeHandler();
    using var http = new HttpClient(new FixtureLiveRecoveryHttpHandler(evidence, "gpt-4.1-mini", "responses", transport));
    using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(new HttpMethod(method), path) { Content = new StringContent(body) };
    if (auth) request.Headers.Authorization = new("Bearer", "private-canary-token");
    try { await http.SendAsync(request); throw new Exception("invalid native wire forwarded"); }
    catch (InvalidOperationException e) when (e.Message == "RECOVERY_WIRE_INVALID") { }
    Check(transport.Calls == 0, "wire rejected after HTTP acquisition");
}
using (var evidence = new FixtureLiveRecoveryEvidence("preflight", TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60), Scope))
{
    var credential = new BudgetCredential(() => View(evidence).GetProperty("calls").GetArrayLength());
    var configuration = new ConfigurationBuilder().AddInMemoryCollection(new Dictionary<string,string?> {
        ["Provider"] = "azure", ["ModelApi"] = "responses", ["Model"] = "gpt-4.1-mini", ["ModelEndpoint"] = "https://native-unit.invalid/", ["AzureAuthentication"] = "azure-cli"
    }).Build();
    var transport = new NativeHandler();
    using var http = new HttpClient(new FixtureLiveRecoveryHttpHandler(evidence, "gpt-4.1-mini", "responses", transport));
    using var client = new FixtureLiveRecoveryClient(ProviderFactory.Create(configuration, new ProviderClientComposition(_ => credential, http)), evidence);
    try { await client.GetResponseAsync([new(ChatRole.User, "failure")]); throw new Exception("failed credential accepted"); } catch (Exception e) when (e.Message != "failed credential accepted") { }
    Check(credential.Calls == 1 && credential.CountedFirst && transport.Calls == 0, "failed credential was retried or acquired before attempt counted");
    Check(View(evidence).GetProperty("calls").GetArrayLength() == 1 && !View(evidence).GetProperty("healthy").GetBoolean(), "failed acquisition certified");
}
using (var evidence = new FixtureLiveRecoveryEvidence("preflight", TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60), Scope))
{
    evidence.Begin([new(ChatRole.User, "redirect")]);
    using var audit = new FixtureLiveRecoveryHttpHandler(evidence, "gpt-4.1-mini");
    Check(audit.InnerHandler is HttpClientHandler { AllowAutoRedirect: false }, "default HTTP transport follows redirects");
    audit.InnerHandler = new RedirectLoopback(audit.InnerHandler!, new Uri(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("LIVE_REDIRECT_LOOPBACK")!));
    using var http = new HttpClient(audit);
    using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "https://native-unit.invalid/v1/responses") { Content = new ByteArrayContent(exact) };
    request.Headers.Authorization = new("Bearer", "private-canary-token");
    using var response = await http.SendAsync(request);
    Check((int)response.StatusCode == 302, "redirect response replaced or followed");
}
using (var evidence = new FixtureLiveRecoveryEvidence("preflight", TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60), Scope))
{
    evidence.Begin([new(ChatRole.User, "cancel body read")]);
    var transport = new NativeHandler();
    using var http = new HttpClient(new FixtureLiveRecoveryHttpHandler(evidence, "gpt-4.1-mini", "responses", transport));
    using var cancel = new CancellationTokenSource();
    using var content = new BlockingBody();
    using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "https://native-unit.invalid/v1/responses") { Content = content };
    request.Headers.Authorization = new("Bearer", "private-canary-token");
    var sending = http.SendAsync(request, cancel.Token);
    await content.Entered.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
    cancel.Cancel();
    try { await sending; throw new Exception("body cancellation ignored"); }
    catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
    Check(transport.Calls == 0, "cancelled body acquired HTTP transport");
}
foreach (var authentication in new[] { "empty-key", "empty-bearer", "ambiguous" })
{
    using var evidence = new FixtureLiveRecoveryEvidence("preflight", TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60), Scope);
    evidence.Begin([new(ChatRole.User, "invalid auth")]);
    var transport = new NativeHandler();
    using var http = new HttpClient(new FixtureLiveRecoveryHttpHandler(evidence, "gpt-4.1-mini", "responses", transport));
    using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "https://native-unit.invalid/v1/responses") { Content = new ByteArrayContent(exact) };
    if (authentication == "empty-bearer") request.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation("Authorization", "Bearer ");
    else { request.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation("api-key", authentication == "empty-key" ? "" : "private-canary-key"); if (authentication == "ambiguous") request.Headers.Authorization = new("Bearer", "private-canary-token"); }
    try { await http.SendAsync(request); throw new Exception("invalid empty/ambiguous auth forwarded"); }
    catch (InvalidOperationException e) when (e.Message == "RECOVERY_WIRE_INVALID") { }
    Check(transport.Calls == 0, "auth rejected after HTTP acquisition");
}
foreach (var destination in new[] { "https://other.invalid/v1/responses", "https://native-unit.invalid/openai/v1/responses", "https://native-unit.invalid/v1/responses?unexpected=1" })
{
    using var evidence = new FixtureLiveRecoveryEvidence("preflight", TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60), Scope);
    evidence.Begin([new(ChatRole.User, "wrong destination")]);
    var transport = new NativeHandler();
    using var http = new HttpClient(new FixtureLiveRecoveryHttpHandler(evidence, "gpt-4.1-mini", "responses", transport, new Uri("https://native-unit.invalid/v1/")));
    using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, destination) { Content = new ByteArrayContent(exact) };
    request.Headers.Authorization = new("Bearer", "private-canary-token");
    try { await http.SendAsync(request); throw new Exception("wrong configured destination forwarded"); }
    catch (InvalidOperationException e) when (e.Message == "RECOVERY_WIRE_INVALID") { }
    Check(transport.Calls == 0, "destination rejected after HTTP acquisition");
}
Console.WriteLine("Release recovery native HTTPS controls passed.");

sealed class ScopeCredential : TokenCredential
{
    public List<string[]> Scopes = [];
    public override AccessToken GetToken(TokenRequestContext context, CancellationToken token) { Scopes.Add(context.Scopes); return new("private-canary-token", DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddHours(1)); }
    public override ValueTask<AccessToken> GetTokenAsync(TokenRequestContext context, CancellationToken token) => ValueTask.FromResult(GetToken(context, token));
}
sealed class NativeHandler : HttpMessageHandler {
    public int Calls; public bool StreamDisposed; public byte[]? ActualBody; public string? ActualPath; public string? ActualAuthentication;
    private const string Response = """{"id":"resp_fixture","object":"response","created_at":1720000000,"model":"gpt-4.1-mini","status":"completed","output":[{"type":"message","id":"msg_fixture","role":"assistant","status":"completed","content":[{"type":"output_text","text":"ok","annotations":[]}]}],"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":1,"total_tokens":2}}""";
    protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken) {
        Calls++;
        ActualBody = await request.Content!.ReadAsByteArrayAsync(cancellationToken);
        ActualPath = request.RequestUri!.AbsolutePath;
        ActualAuthentication = request.Headers.Contains("api-key") ? "api-key" : request.Headers.Authorization?.Scheme == "Bearer" ? "bearer" : "missing";
        using var body = JsonDocument.Parse(ActualBody);
        if (body.RootElement.TryGetProperty("stream", out var stream) && stream.GetBoolean()) {
            var response = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<JsonElement>(Response);
            var message = response.GetProperty("output")[0];
            var part = message.GetProperty("content")[0];
            var events = new List<string>();
            void Emit(string type, object data) {
                var payload = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(data).EnumerateObject().ToDictionary(item => item.Name, item => (object?)item.Value.Clone());
                payload["type"] = type; payload["sequence_number"] = events.Count;
                events.Add($"event: {type}\ndata: {JsonSerializer.Serialize(payload)}\n\n");
            }
            Emit("response.created", new { response = new { id = "resp_fixture", @object = "response", created_at = 1720000000, model = "gpt-4.1-mini", status = "in_progress", output = Array.Empty<object>() } });
            Emit("response.output_item.added", new { output_index = 0, item = new { type = "message", id = "msg_fixture", role = "assistant", status = "in_progress", content = Array.Empty<object>() } });
            Emit("response.content_part.added", new { item_id = "msg_fixture", output_index = 0, content_index = 0, part = new { type = "output_text", text = "", annotations = Array.Empty<object>() } });
            Emit("response.output_text.delta", new { item_id = "msg_fixture", output_index = 0, content_index = 0, delta = "ok", logprobs = Array.Empty<object>() });
            Emit("response.output_text.done", new { item_id = "msg_fixture", output_index = 0, content_index = 0, text = "ok", logprobs = Array.Empty<object>() });
            Emit("response.content_part.done", new { item_id = "msg_fixture", output_index = 0, content_index = 0, part });
            Emit("response.output_item.done", new { output_index = 0, item = message });
            Emit("response.completed", new { response });
            var content = new StreamContent(new ObservedStream(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(string.Concat(events)), () => StreamDisposed = true));
            content.Headers.ContentType = new("text/event-stream");
            return new HttpResponseMessage(System.Net.HttpStatusCode.OK) { Content = content };
        }
        return new HttpResponseMessage(System.Net.HttpStatusCode.OK) { Content = new StringContent(Response, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json") };
    }
}
sealed class ObservedStream(byte[] bytes, Action disposed) : MemoryStream(bytes) {
    protected override void Dispose(bool disposing) { disposed(); base.Dispose(disposing); }
}
sealed class BudgetCredential(Func<int> count) : TokenCredential {
    public int Calls; public bool CountedFirst;
    public override AccessToken GetToken(TokenRequestContext requestContext, CancellationToken cancellationToken) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public override ValueTask<AccessToken> GetTokenAsync(TokenRequestContext requestContext, CancellationToken cancellationToken) {
        Calls++; CountedFirst = count() == 1;
        return ValueTask.FromException<AccessToken>(new Exception("secret-canary", new Exception("secret-canary")));
    }
}
sealed class DisposeFailureClient : IChatClient, IAsyncEnumerable<ChatResponseUpdate>, IAsyncEnumerator<ChatResponseUpdate> {
    public ChatResponseUpdate Current => new(ChatRole.Assistant, "native-text");
    public IAsyncEnumerator<ChatResponseUpdate> GetAsyncEnumerator(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) => this;
    public ValueTask<bool> MoveNextAsync() => ValueTask.FromResult(true);
    public ValueTask DisposeAsync() => ValueTask.FromException(new Exception("secret-canary"));
    public IAsyncEnumerable<ChatResponseUpdate> GetStreamingResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) => this;
    public Task<ChatResponse> GetResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public object? GetService(Type serviceType, object? serviceKey = null) => null;
    public void Dispose() { }
}
sealed class RedirectLoopback(HttpMessageHandler inner, Uri loopback) : DelegatingHandler(inner) {
    protected override Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken) {
        request.RequestUri = new Uri(loopback, request.RequestUri!.AbsolutePath);
        return base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
    }
}


sealed class BlockingBody : HttpContent
{
    public TaskCompletionSource Entered = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    protected override bool TryComputeLength(out long length) { length = 0; return false; }
    protected override Task SerializeToStreamAsync(Stream stream, System.Net.TransportContext? context) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    protected override async Task SerializeToStreamAsync(Stream stream, System.Net.TransportContext? context, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    { Entered.TrySetResult(); await Task.Delay(Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan, cancellationToken); }
}
